name: Anime Blues Con
blurb: A 3-day anime convention at the Renasant Convention Center in downtown Memphis, Tennessee, now in its 14th+ year.

editions.evidence: The seed's animebluescon.com domain is dead (redirects to an unrelated 'searchhounds.com' ad page), so the con's real site animeblues.com was used instead; it still shows last edition's dates ('July 10th – 12th, 2026'). The con's own registration listing on Eventeny (hosted by 'VXV Events LLC', matching the organizer) carries JSON-LD SocialEvent data for the next edition: 'Anime Blues Con 2027' 2027-07-09T10:00 to 2027-07-11T11:00 at Renasant Convention Center, Memphis, confirmed again in its visible text 'Starts on Friday, July 9th, 2027' / 'Jul 09, 2027 · 10:00 AM - Jul 11, 2027 · 11:00 AM'.

notes: Seed URL (animebluescon.com) is expired/parked and now redirects to an unrelated ad page ('searchhounds.com' how-to-watch-anime guide) -- replaced with the con's real official domain, animeblues.com, found via search and confirmed by its own GUESTS/REGISTRATION pages and matching VXV Events organizer. animeblues.com itself has not yet been updated past the July 2026 edition (homepage and the /guests/ page both still show 'July 10th – 12th, 2026' and the full 2026 lineup), so the 2027 lineup is 'none-yet'; the 2027 dates and venue instead come from the con's own listing on Eventeny (their registration/ticketing platform, hosted under the VXV Events LLC account). Re-check animeblues.com/guests/ closer to July 2027 for the next lineup.
